dares.text: Do your solo's first 8 counts like a robot
Dance your solo's first 8 counts in super slow motion
Waddle like a penguin across the room, then strike a pose
Go floppy like cooked spaghetti, then snap into first position
Do your port de bras with the biggest, most dramatic face you can
Teach a stuffed animal one step from your solo
Wiggle like jelly for 10 seconds, then hold a perfect relevé
Make up a 4-count dance that means "good morning"
Walk across the room like a flamingo, a cat, then a ballerina
Dance 8 counts like you're trying not to sneeze
Get a grown-up to copy your moves for 30 seconds
Spell your name with your body, one shape per letter
Hold a passé for 5 seconds on each side
Rise to relevé and hold for 10 seconds without wobbling
Do 3 clean pirouette preps, then one single turn, each side
Do 4 chaînés in a straight line and spot every one
8 tendus front, side and back with pointed toes, each leg
Hold an arabesque for 5 seconds, arms soft, on each side
March and clap on every count of 8, then only on 1 and 5
Do your solo's first 8 counts on your other side
Do 4 pliés: 4 counts down and 4 counts up, nice and slow
8 little sautés in first position with pointed toes
Balance a soft toy on your head while you walk on flat feet
Freestyle and freeze each time a grown-up says "freeze!"
Strike 5 statue poses and hold each one for 5 seconds
Dance for 20 seconds, then freeze in a star shape
Freeze with a surprised face, then a happy face, then a fierce one
Freeze high, freeze middle, freeze low, then do it again faster
Hold your solo's ending pose for 10 seconds like the music just stopped
Freeze in the tiniest shape you can, then the biggest
Dance, then freeze on one foot. Can you hold it for 3 counts?
Freestyle to the next song for 30 seconds without stopping
Do your solo's first 8 counts in hip hop style
Walk to the kitchen like a ballerina going on stage
Add jazz hands to every move for one whole chorus
Dance to a slow song using only your arms and upper body
Do the same 8 counts happy, then sad, then excited
Invent a brand-new move and give it a funny name
Freestyle for 20 seconds using high, middle and low levels
Travel across the room with a new step every 8 counts
Dance a whole chorus using only your fingers and wrists
Do a big Broadway finish: kick ball change, arms up, huge smile
Move like water for 30 seconds: smooth, slow, never stopping
Make a rhythm with just your feet: stomp, tap, tap, stomp
